notes: §1985:VI.6.21.2 prints four PERFORM formats, each out-of-line or inline, with BY underlined in VARYING and every AFTER ('BY identifier-4 UNTIL condition-1') and no index-name alternative in the BY brace. performStatement and its phrase rules parse the superset, BindPerform binds one control phrase, and the later additions are refused at 85 (COBOL0900): omitted BY in VARYING and in AFTER (VisitPerformVarying, VisitPerformVaryingAfter), UNTIL EXIT (VisitPerformUntilTarget), and AFTER in an inline PERFORM (§1985:VI.6.21.3 SR2, VisitPerformVaryingAfter). The BY-brace defect of the prior PARTIAL is closed: BindVaryingOperand now refuses an index-name in the BY slot (COBOL2119 'An index-name is not admitted here'), as it refuses an arithmetic expression. Probed at --std 85: (d) BY IY index-name refused (also at 2023); (b) omitted BY, WITH TEST and no UNTIL, TEST after UNTIL, empty inline body, END-PERFORM after a procedure-name, TIMES with UNTIL, THRU with no name, BY I + 1, -2 TIMES and 0 TIMES all refused; positive: plain, THRU, THROUGH n TIMES, inline TIMES, TEST AFTER UNTIL, VARYING with AFTER, index VARYING FROM index BY -1 TEST AFTER (X03 X02 X01), 0-valued identifier TIMES (no execution) all ran as required; (f) VARYING I FROM I where I=99 UNTIL I > 98 ran zero times and AFTER I FROM J BY J (operand changed by the loop) gave 4 executions. Classes a, e do not reach a format. The witness runs the four formats with identifier and literal BY operands. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5177 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-05.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-05-refute.json).

next.reason: §1985:VI.6.21.2 gives four PERFORM formats (simple, TIMES, UNTIL, VARYING), each out-of-line or inline, with BY required in every VARYING and AFTER phrase. §2023:14.9.28.2 recasts them as 'Format 1 (out-of-line)' and 'Format 2 (inline)' over times-phrase, until-phrase and varying-phrase; every 1985 PERFORM still fits and means the same, but the 2023 format accepts programs the 1985 one refuses: BY is bracketed (its meaning given by §2023:14.9.28.4 GR12, 'For any BY phrase that is omitted, the augment value is 1'), UNTIL EXIT is added, the inline varying-phrase takes AFTER, which §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR2 forbade ('if procedure-name-1 is omitted, the AFTER phrase must not be specified'; 2023 has no such rule), and a 'Format 3 (exception-checking)' is added. Wider syntax, nothing made an exception condition: CHANGED. The syntax rules each carry their own 1985 rule, so the record names the format.
